issues.description: Element: class name in the UML diagram inside the problem statement. The UML block in problem_statement.md declares the class as 'Course' (problem_statement.md lines 63-74) while the provided template and solution define and refer to a class named 'Lecture' (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java). This naming mismatch between the diagram and the code/text can confuse students about which class they are expected to implement and test (whether to follow the UML 'Course' or the code 'Lecture').
issues.suggestedFix: Make the class name consistent across artifacts. Update the UML diagram in problem_statement.md (lines 63-74) to declare the class as 'Lecture' so it matches the template and solution. If the intended name was 'Course', instead rename the template and solution class and update textual references accordingly. Also scan the problem statement for any other occurrences of the old name and align them.
